lastCompletedStory.title: Wire commitExistsForStory from host + loop with anchored git detection

nextStoryContext: US-002 is done: loop.ts's RunSupervisorOptions gained an optional commitExistsForStory field (threaded straight into the readWorkerOutcome call); host.ts builds the real adapter (git branch --show-current + git log --format=%s <branch>, matched via commitSubjectMatchesStory from result.ts, US-001). Design decision worth knowing for US-003: decideNextAction (decide.ts) is purely a function of prd.json's passes booleans and has zero awareness of commit state, so a 'no-commit' outcome cannot be handled by merely `continue`-ing the outer loop (the next decideNextAction call would take prd.json's passes:true at face value and advance to review/next-story). The fix implemented: a NEW dedicated `if (outcome.kind === 'no-commit')` block in loop.ts, placed right after the existing blocked/fail/unknown immediate-block check, that notifies + finishTerminal('blocked') + returns blocked on the very FIRST occurrence (no streak/backoff/retry loop like CAM-36/CAM-44 -- retrying is pointless here since a fresh worker session would just see passes:true and move on to the next story, it would not create the missing commit). This trivially satisfies 'bounded, never spins to MAX_ITERATIONS': every subsequent supervisor run (via a new `cam next`) hits the same guard on iteration 1. finalizeStory is never invoked for this outcome (kept structurally separate from the 'incomplete' branch). requires:'operator' stories remain exempt via the existing confirmCommitGate/isOperatorStory helpers in result.ts (unchanged, verified with a discriminating loop-level test). Next story per prd.json priority order is US-003 (worker-isolation-aware per-worker sentinel timeout ceiling) -- unrelated surface (perWorkerTimeoutMs / workerIsolation in loop.ts), no dependency on this story's work.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Fetched git-log docs to confirm --format=%s prints one commit subject line per commit reachable from <branch>, most recent first; matches the new host.ts commitExistsForStory adapter and the pre-existing --pretty=%s usage in ship-bump.ts/status.ts/resume.ts.
